meta.title: Aurelio Ochoa
meta.description: Aurelio Ochoa: software developer, certified agricultural drone pilot, trained cook. Guayaquil, Ecuador.

three.note: My work takes me between technology, farmland and the kitchen.

code.head: I build software and keep it running.
code.body: I have three years of experience in web development, systems administration and cloud infrastructure. I build websites and features, maintain Linux servers and databases, and automate testing and deployments.

stack.front: HTML, CSS, Sass, JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular
stack.back: Node.js, Express, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, MySQL, MongoDB
stack.ops: Linux, Docker, Jenkins, Google Cloud Platform, CI/CD
stack.ai: Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and workflows with AI agents

shipped.head: Selected work
shipped.mediacor: I built the corporate website and automated email delivery for their media-monitoring subscriptions.
shipped.publifyer: I developed features for Just Click Media’s e-commerce platform, worked on storefronts and carried out quality assurance testing.
shipped.uneatlantico: I developed WordPress themes in PHP and automations with Apps Script. I also worked on Jenkins pipelines and infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.

shelf.head: In the open
shelf.body: Explore my public repositories and the code behind the projects.

sky.head: I fly agricultural drones in Ecuador.
sky.body: Since 2024, I have flown precision spraying missions in Ecuador. I map fields, plan routes and prepare each operation through equipment maintenance and calibration.

fly.head: Take the controls.
fly.body: The drone has flown itself this far. Turn on the controller and try flying it.
fly.fallback: The drone is unavailable in this browser. You can still explore the page.

rc.fly: Fly with W A S D, spray with F

kitchen.head: I trained in the kitchen, too.
kitchen.body: In February 2026, I completed my culinary arts program at the Escuela Culinaria de las Américas in Guayaquil. Another craft that calls for technique, attention to detail and coordination during every service.

close.head: Let's build something.
close.line: Have a project in mind? Tell me what you want to do and how I can help.
